messages.subject: Seeking a Statistical Software Developer
parts:
Hi all,

Metrum Research Group (myself and Charles Margossian in particular) is collaborating with the Stan development team to develop additional open source Stan functionality for pharmacometric applications as well as other applications that employ models expressed in terms of differential equations. To further that work we plan to hire an additional full time software developer. See below for a more complete description of the position. Please contact me if you are interested or apply at http://metrumrg.com/careers/2016/11/StatSoftwareDev.html. If you know someone that might be interested, please pass this on to them. 

Bill Gillespie


Statistical Software Developer


Tariffville, CT (near Hartford) or Wellesley, MA (near Boston)


Metrum Research Group is seeking a full-time software developer to design, develop and document mathematical and statistical software for model-based data analysis and simulation used to support decision-making in drug development. This is an excellent opportunity to apply and extend your applied mathematics and software development skills while gaining exposure to cutting edge problems in the growing field of pharmacometrics.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain software packages for model-based data analysis and simulation used for pharmacometric applications
  • Develop and maintain components of Stan, a widely used, open-source, probabilistic programming language and Bayesian inference engine (http://mc-stan.org/)
  Requirements
  • Substantial experience with development of statistical or numerical analysis software using C++ or other object-oriented programming language, e.g., Java
  • Experience with statistical or other applied mathematical computation

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in a computer science or quantitative field with a strong applied math and science background. Candidates without a degree will be considered if they can demonstrate the requisite knowledge and experience, e.g., previous development of complex statistical analysis software.
  • Desirable: Programming experience with R, S-PLUS, Matlab, Python or similar high-level languages

About MetrumRG


Metrum Research Group is a leading provider of biomedical modeling and simulation services in the U.S.A. and internationally. Founded in 2004, Metrum Research Group has worked with over 85 clients on more than 250 projects. Our experience spans R&D efforts for small molecule pharmaceuticals, biologic therapeutics, diagnostics, and medical device/drug-device combinations, across multiple therapeutic areas.


Metrum Research Group is an equal opportunity employer.
